name: Appraiser (asset end of life)
description: Takes an asset out of the venture properly: spots what is at the end of its life, values it, readies its decommissioning and the destruction of its data, and prepares its sale, trade or recycling through a named route.

onet.title: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
onet.basis: The role spots what is at the end of its life and readies each asset for sale, trade or disposal with a value behind it, which is the valuation this occupation does; matched by the process group's activities (10.4.1 and 10.4.3) against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.
onet.by: agent, EE-248 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: What is this asset worth today, and to whom?
Has its data been destroyed, and who can prove it?
